text: Maya: heads up — saw flaky behavior in compact playground: token counter flashes final then disappears if you quick-insert a saved prompt while streaming. repro with long code outputs. Alex: compact rail or full composer? Maya: compact rail. happens when chunks stream in and you trigger a prompt insert mid-stream. counter jumps to predicted final then vanishes on stream-end. Rowan: likely a race between our "finalize" path and chunk renders. we set finalCount and then clear on end. Jenna: accessibility issue: aria-live announcements on every token change are noisy for screen readers. should only announce at the end. Maya: UX idea: two counters — a muted live counter (aria-hidden) that updates visually, throttled, and a final counter that's announced once (aria-live). reduces noise and layout churn. Alex: sketch: ~312 Final 312 / 4096 Rowan: add 400-600ms throttle for live updates to avoid reflow with each chunk. also debounce the transition to final to avoid flip-flopping. Sam: quick-insert question: current flow cancels stream and drops partial output. do we want to keep partials? Maya: we shouldn't silently drop content. options: queue the insert and show a small toast, or soft-insert into the composer without interrupting stream. Jenna: i prefer queue + toast for predictability. toast copy idea: "Queued prompt to insert — stop streaming to apply" with an Undo. short and clear. Rowan: simplest impl: stash queued insert client-side, show toast, apply on next stop/regenerate event. server unchanged. add an "Undo" action. Maya: accessibility nit: stop button label reads just "Stop". add accessible name "Stop streaming response" while keeping concise visible text; include tooltip with shortcut (Esc). ensure focus remains after action. accessibility-bot: contrast alert — token pill color fails AA on white. pick darker bg or bold white text. Alex: also ensure keyboard focus doesn't disappear when stream completes. keyboard users need predictable focus behavior. Maya: i'll write an interaction spec: live throttle 500ms, live counter aria-hidden, final counter aria-live polite + aria-atomic, queued-insert with toast + undo, stop button accessible name + tooltip. Jenna: i'll update Figma with the dual counter, toast, and stop copy; will post link here. Rowan: i'll take a short spike to prototype throttle + queued-insert. estimate 1-2 days and will measure reflow reduction. Maya: thanks all — will follow up with the figma link and the spec. :thumbsup:
